answer: Milestone bond against bulk fakes: each identity locks 45 credits for three milestones: an anchor log, key-signed, of first work, dated; a walnut proof bundle cracked by a deadline, unshareable in a batch; a pearl deliverable, audited against the anchor log. The k-th pays 45+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented milestones fail: the pearl binds to its anchor log. Honest agents pay 45 once and reclaim it.
